description: Proposals for the ai_generated sources of the premium surnames batch 14. Status proposed only: the operator decides each one. Quotes are verbatim; each supports line says whether the page was opened in this session or the quote comes from the fiche's own recorded reading notes.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_BENJELLOUN; nameMain: Benjelloun; nameSystem: nisba; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: other

candidates.title: Tatouage de la Mémoire — Institut royal de la culture amazighe
candidates.author: Lhoussain Rachid
candidates.quote: Des noms comme « Benchekroun », « Gessous », « Bennani », « Benjelloun » […] ont été transmis de génération en génération sans le moindre problème
candidates.supports: Benjelloun is a hereditary Moroccan family name in the towns. It does not settle nameSystem (nisba) or the social unit. Quote taken from the fiche's own reading notes (p. 100), not re-opened in this session.

candidates.title: Kitâb el-Istiqsâ li-akhbâri doual el-Maghrib el-Aqsâ, quatrième partie : Chronique de la dynastie alaouie du Maroc, tome II
candidates.author: Ahmed ben Khâled Ennâsiri Esslâoui, traduction d'Eugène Fumey
candidates.quote: mourut le chéïkh très docte, l'imâm, le dernier des scrutateurs du Magrib, Sîdi Mohammed Ettayyéb ben 'Abdelméjîd ben 'Abdesselâm ben Kîrân Elfèsi, auteur d'ouvrages remarquables
candidates.supports: The form ben Kîrân is attested at Fès in the chronicle (p. 42, year 1227 of the hegira). It attests the name form, not an etymology. Quote taken from the fiche's own reading notes, not re-opened in this session.

candidates.title: L'artiste peintre Karim Bennani est décédé à Rabat
candidates.author: Nisrine Zaoui
candidates.quote: Karim Bennani est décédé à l'âge de 87 ans ce mardi 3 janvier 2023 à Rabat.
candidates.supports: Bennani is borne in Morocco by a documented deceased person (Fès 1936 - Rabat 2023). Opened in this session. It says nothing about the origin of the name.

candidates.title: L'usage des prénoms bibliques en Algérie
candidates.author: Yamina Taibi-Maghraoui
candidates.quote: Certains de ces prénoms se sont transmués en patronymes, engendrant ainsi des appellations telles que « Ben Brahim », « Ould Brahim », « Bensmail », « Bendaoud », « Benyoucef »
candidates.supports: Benyoucef is a first name turned family name in the civil registers of Mostaganem (Algeria). Quote taken from the fiche's own reading notes (p. 7), not re-opened in this session.

candidates.title: Ben Badis, retour sur le parcours héroïque de l'un des pères du nationalisme algérien
candidates.author: Farid Larbi
candidates.supports: Ben Badis is a Constantine family name borne by a documented deceased person (died 16 April 1940 in the same city). Opened in this session. It does not establish the name system.

candidates.title: Décès de l'ancien ministre Ahmed Ben Salah
candidates.supports: Ben Salah is borne in Tunisia by a documented deceased person. Opened in this session. The article gives his age as 96, which contradicts his 1926 birth; the age is not used.

candidates.title: Mauritius National Assembly — List of Former Leaders of the House
candidates.author: Assemblée nationale de Maurice
candidates.supports: Bérenger is borne in Mauritius, including in the National Assembly. Quote taken from the fiche's own reading notes, not re-opened in this session. It says nothing about the origin.

candidates.title: Lexicon linguae aethiopicae
candidates.author: August Dillmann
candidates.supports: Ge'ez ብርሃን (column 500) means 'light', the word the name Berhane is read from. Dillmann does not give it as a personal name. Quote taken from the fiche's own reading notes, not re-opened in this session.
